title: New-Place Discovery Rate
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=location:visit
| streamstats dc(place) as places_seen
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats max(places_seen) as cumulative by _time
| delta cumulative as new_places
| sort _time
description: Counts how many genuinely new places you visit each month versus returning to familiar ones.
value: A discovery rate is a gentle nudge against routine and toward exploring your own city and world.
implementation: Ingest location history into `index=personal`; count first-time places per month.
visualization: Column chart of new places discovered per month.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many brand-new places you visit each month, nudging you to keep exploring.
